title: Weather and zero-shot forecasting models: backtest results for GB electricity demand (part 1 of 2)
claim: In a preregistered 960-day day-ahead backtest of GB national demand, giving every model the same honestly timed weather forecasts cut error by about a third for a weekly-lag regression and Chronos-2 and less for Timestral-209M and TimesFM 2.5, and the models' lead over the regression largely disappears once the regression has weather.

title: Benchmarking Time Series Foundation Models for Load Forecasting Under Covariate Uncertainty
